title: UI风格#18 - Zen Minimal (禅意极简)
description: 创建第18种UI风格：禅意极简风格 - 留白大量、水墨感、单色层次。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planR.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Zen Minimal style When color palette Then features ink blacks, rice whites, subtle grays, single accent
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: #1A1A1A ink black, #F5F5F3 rice white, #8B4513 ochre accent, #FAFAF8 ivory background

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Zen Minimal style When typography Then uses brush-style fonts: Ma Shan Zheng, Noto Serif SC, or EB Garamond
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Ma Shan Zheng (headers), Noto Serif SC (body), EB Garamond (accents)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Zen Minimal style When layout Then extreme whitespace, single focal point, ink wash textures
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: 70%+ whitespace, single focal composition, ink wash gradient textures

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Zen Minimal style When UI elements Then subtle borders, ink brush accents, single-line interactions
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: 1px subtle borders, ink blur effects, single-line hover animations

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Zen Minimal UI When functional Then includes zen chat, minimal agents, ink stat display
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: zen chat interface, minimal agent cards, ink-style stat display

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Zen Minimal UI When copy Then uses poetic minimal: 'Empty', 'Still', 'Breath', 'Now'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'EMPTY. STILL. NOW.', buttons BIDDEN/RELEASE/DISSOLVE/BREATHE, status BREATHING/SETTLING
